description: Under several general anesthetics, the apical and basal compartments of layer 5 pyramidal neurons were functionally decoupled, the coupling depended on metabotropic receptors, and suppressing higher-order thalamus also decoupled them (Suzuki and Larkum 2020, as reported in the read reviews).
limitations: Reported secondhand in Storm et al. 2024 and Aru, Larkum and Shine 2023. The original Cell paper is not read here. Rodent data from the originators’ laboratory, with no independent replication found in the read texts.

sources.quote: Loss of consciousness due to anesthesia correlates with a decoupling of the apical from the basal dendrites in these neurons.
the authors provided suggestive evidence that the activity of the metabotropic receptors might be controlled by the higher-order thalamus
